description: Publish a ready-made video file directly to social accounts — no generation, no schedule. Reads a local video (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB) and posts it immediately via POST /api/upload-content. YouTube requires title, description, tags, and privacyStatus; Rumble and Fanvue require title and description; Instagram/Bluesky/LinkedIn/Threads/Facebook/3Speak require caption.

accountIds.description: Target accounts: the IDs from list_social_accounts (channel IDs for YouTube, IG user IDs for Instagram, DIDs for Bluesky, member IDs or org URNs for LinkedIn, user IDs for Threads, Page IDs for Facebook, user IDs for Pinterest, Fanvue account IDs, Hive usernames for 3Speak, Channel IDs for Rumble).

boardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to publish the pin to (the id from list_pinterest_boards). Required for pinterest.

caption.description: Instagram/Bluesky/LinkedIn/Threads/Facebook/3Speak: required caption. Pinterest: used as the pin description when description is omitted.

description.description: YouTube/Rumble/Fanvue: required video description. Pinterest: pin description (optional; caption is used when omitted).

provider.description: The social platform to publish the video to.

tags.description: YouTube only: required list of tags.

title.description: YouTube/Rumble/Fanvue: required video title. Pinterest: pin title (optional).

videoPath.description: Local path to the video file (.mp4 or .mov, max 2GB). The video is published as-is: no generation, no schedule.

name: publish_video_direct
